story_overview: A group of friends, including Piper, Kaito, and a large inflatable robot, hang out in San Fransokyo Plaza. Elsewhere, Finn accidentally brings a graffiti art monster to life, which escapes. At a media event, the luchador Rico has an angry outburst during an interview with Alistair.

video_prompts:
Piper: Tall, slender young woman with fair skin, green eyes, and long, straight honey-blonde hair, wearing large magenta-framed glasses, a pink headband, a bright yellow short-sleeved mini-dress with a wide collar over magenta leggings, and yellow platform wedges.
Kaito: Young man with a slender build, messy black hair, and a slight gap between his front teeth, wearing a blue zip-up hoodie over a red crew-neck t-shirt, dark gray cargo capris, and dark sneakers with yellow laces.
San Fransokyo Plaza: Outdoor urban park plaza with manicured green grass sections, wide paved pathways, stylized modern benches, and unique street lamps, surrounded by colorful San Fransokyo architecture blending Victorian-style buildings with Japanese pagoda roofs and design elements.
the telescoping selfie stick: A rectangular smartphone with a dark screen mounted in a plastic clamp at the end of a black, telescoping selfie stick with a textured handle grip.
the inflatable white robot: Large, inflatable white robot with a soft, rotund, marshmallow-like body, puffy cylindrical limbs, two small round black eyes connected by a thin black line, and a small circular grey access port on its chest.

In `San Fransokyo Plaza` during the day, `Piper`, `Kaito`, and `the inflatable white robot` are standing together. `Kaito` excitedly holds up `the telescoping selfie stick`, causing `Piper` and `the inflatable white robot` to turn toward him in surprise, then begin to smile for the photo.

the graffiti art monster: Large, colorful robotic monster with a body resembling graffiti art, featuring vibrant, saturated block colors and thick black outlines.
the black video game controller: Black plastic video game controller with an ergonomic shape, two analog thumbsticks, a directional pad, four colored face buttons, and shoulder bumpers and triggers.
